speaker_title: Address by Ms. Erna Solberg, Prime Minister of Norway

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: Ladies and gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Ladies and gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: The United Nations was founded on hope — the hope for a better tomorrow in the aftermath of war. As we meet today, 75 years later, COVID-19 is putting us all to the test: Will we tackle the largest global challenge since the UN was established?
paragraphs.raw_text:
The United Nations was founded on hope — the hope for a better tomorrow in 
the aftermath of war. As we meet today, 75 years later, COVID-19 is putting us all 
to the test: Will we tackle the largest global challenge since the UN was established?

paragraphs.text: Building on the lessons from other crises and infectious diseases, Norway continues our unwavering commitment to the UN and multilateral solutions. In response to the pandemic, we took the initiative to establish a UN COVID-19 response and recovery fund, and we are co-chairing the global effort on access to COVID-19 tests, treatments and vaccines — the ACT Accelerator.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Building on the lessons from other crises and infectious diseases, Norway 
continues our unwavering commitment to the UN and multilateral solutions. In 
response to the pandemic, we took the initiative to establish a UN COVID-19 response 
and recovery fund, and we are co-chairing the global effort on access to COVID-19 
tests, treatments and vaccines — the ACT Accelerator.

paragraphs.text: We stand firm in our conviction that global problems need global solutions.
paragraphs.raw_text: We stand firm in our conviction that global problems need global solutions.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: The goal of the UN is a world of peace and security. A world ruled by justice and respect for human rights. A world that acts decisively to reduce inequality, poverty and hunger. Acts to stem climate change. And acts to build resilience against pandemics and other global threats.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The goal of the UN is a world of peace and security. A world ruled by justice 
and respect for human rights. A world that acts decisively to reduce inequality, 
poverty and hunger. Acts to stem climate change. And acts to build resilience against 
pandemics and other global threats.

paragraphs.text: We celebrate 75 years of the United Nations. In the next seventy-five years, how many new conflicts will emerge? How many new refugees will flee from destruction and persecution? How many girls will attend school? How many children will be vaccinated?
paragraphs.raw_text:
We celebrate 75 years of the United Nations. In the next seventy-five years, 
how many new conflicts will emerge? How many new refugees will flee from 
destruction and persecution? How many girls will attend school? How many children 
will be vaccinated?

paragraphs.text: Whatever old challenges remain and new challenges arise in the next 75 years, the UN must be at the centre of our coordinated efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Whatever old challenges remain and new challenges arise in the next 75 years, 
the UN must be at the centre of our coordinated efforts.

paragraphs.text: This is why we continue to invest both financially and politically in this organization.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is why we continue to invest both financially and politically in 
this organization.

paragraphs.text: I would like to pay tribute to the many deeply committed women and men who represent the United Nations across the globe. Civilian as well as uniformed. You deserve our gratitude and respect.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to pay tribute to the many deeply committed women and men who 
represent the United Nations across the globe. Civilian as well as uniformed. You 
deserve our gratitude and respect.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: In June, Norway was elected as one of five incoming members of the UN Security Council. We are grateful for the strong vote of confidence from the Member States. We are preparing for this assignment fully aware that it is one of the most important and demanding tasks in international politics.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In June, Norway was elected as one of five incoming members of the UN 
Security Council. We are grateful for the strong vote of confidence from the Member 
States. We are preparing for this assignment fully aware that it is one of the most 
important and demanding tasks in international politics.

paragraphs.text: Throughout our campaign, we strengthened bilateral bonds with all UN Member States. We pledged to listen and engage. To be open for dialogue with all countries. We will honour that commitment.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Throughout our campaign, we strengthened bilateral bonds with all UN 
Member States. We pledged to listen and engage. To be open for dialogue with all 
countries. We will honour that commitment.

paragraphs.text: In addressing country situations on the Security Council’s agenda, Norway will focus on four thematic areas in particular.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addressing country situations on the Security Council’s agenda, Norway 
will focus on four thematic areas in particular.

paragraphs.text: First, we will use our experience from peace diplomacy to help fulfil the UN’s untapped potential to prevent and resolve conflicts and sustain peace.
paragraphs.raw_text:
First, we will use our experience from peace diplomacy to help fulfil the UN’s 
untapped potential to prevent and resolve conflicts and sustain peace.

paragraphs.text: Second, we will build on the women, peace and security agenda and promote women’s participation in peace processes. Only an inclusive process can lead to sustainable peace for all.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Second, we will build on the women, peace and security agenda and promote 
women’s participation in peace processes. Only an inclusive process can lead to 
sustainable peace for all.

paragraphs.text: Third, Norway will focus on the protection of civilians, including children, based on international humanitarian and human rights law. We will give special priority to preventing and combating sexual violence in conflict.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Third, Norway will focus on the protection of civilians, including children, 
based on international humanitarian and human rights law. We will give special 
priority to preventing and combating sexual violence in conflict.

paragraphs.text: Fourth, Norway will bring climate-related security threats into the discussion. We must acknowledge that people living in conflict zones are among the most vulnerable to climate change, and that climate change in turn increases the risk of conflict.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Fourth, Norway will bring climate-related security threats into the discussion. 
We must acknowledge that people living in conflict zones are among the most 
vulnerable to climate change, and that climate change in turn increases the risk 
of conflict.

paragraphs.text: The Security Council has a primary responsibility for maintaining international peace and security. The Council should investigate any dispute or situation that might lead to international friction. And the Council should apply appropriate measures to stop aggression or prevent escalation of conflict.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Security Council has a primary responsibility for maintaining international 
peace and security. The Council should investigate any dispute or situation that might 
lead to international friction. And the Council should apply appropriate measures to 
stop aggression or prevent escalation of conflict.

paragraphs.text: This is at the heart of the Security Council, and at the heart of the UN. Because there can be no development without peace.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is at the heart of the Security Council, and at the heart of the UN. Because 
there can be no development without peace.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: Human rights, the rule of law and democratic principles are the building blocks of just, peaceful and prosperous societies. Societies where citizens are protected and leaders are held accountable.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Human rights, the rule of law and democratic principles are the building blocks 
of just, peaceful and prosperous societies. Societies where citizens are protected and 
leaders are held accountable.

paragraphs.text: Today, we are witnessing a different trend towards more authoritarianism and populism. Civil society, human rights defenders and media workers are increasingly coming under attack. The basic human rights of women are being undermined. Minorities are being targeted and vilified.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Today, we are witnessing a different trend towards more authoritarianism and 
populism. Civil society, human rights defenders and media workers are increasingly 
coming under attack. The basic human rights of women are being undermined. 
Minorities are being targeted and vilified.

paragraphs.text: The pandemic is amplifying this negative trend. We have seen examples of the pandemic being used as a pretext to weaken democratic principles and human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The pandemic is amplifying this negative trend. We have seen examples of the 
pandemic being used as a pretext to weaken democratic principles and human rights.

paragraphs.text: The pandemic is an exam in practical governance for all states. The report card will be open for the world to see.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The pandemic is an exam in practical governance for all states. The report card 
will be open for the world to see.

paragraphs.text: We must ensure that human rights, democracy, the rule of law, and gender equality are at the core of our response and recovery efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We must ensure that human rights, democracy, the rule of law, and gender 
equality are at the core of our response and recovery efforts.

paragraphs.text: Only then can we hope not only to soften the fall, but to build back better.
paragraphs.raw_text: Only then can we hope not only to soften the fall, but to build back better.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: I am shocked and saddened by the increase in violence against women and girls as a result of ongoing lockdowns across the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I am shocked and saddened by the increase in violence against women and 
girls as a result of ongoing lockdowns across the world.

paragraphs.text: Women are bearing the brunt of the pandemic in many societies. Women are on the front line as health care workers. At the same time, women’s own access to health care is heavily affected. Denying women access to sexual and reproductive health services can lead to more maternal deaths, more teenage pregnancies and more child marriages. We must ensure that women and girls are protected. That they have access to health care. And that women have access to financial incentives for response and recovery.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Women are bearing the brunt of the pandemic in many societies. Women are 
on the front line as health care workers. At the same time, women’s own access to 
health care is heavily affected. Denying women access to sexual and reproductive 
health services can lead to more maternal deaths, more teenage pregnancies and 
more child marriages. We must ensure that women and girls are protected. That they 
have access to health care. And that women have access to financial incentives for 
response and recovery.

paragraphs.text: Norway has a long tradition of promoting women’s rights and gender equality. We know from our own experience that it is not just the right thing to do — it is the smart thing to do. Gender equality is well worth the investments. If we are to achieve the UN Sustainable Development Goals, gender equality must be integrated in all our efforts. We must invest in girls and women. In their education, in their health, and in their participation in the labour market. Increasing their opportunities and levelling the playing field pays great economic dividends.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Norway has a long tradition of promoting women’s rights and gender equality. 
We know from our own experience that it is not just the right thing to do — it is the 
smart thing to do. Gender equality is well worth the investments. If we are to achieve 
the UN Sustainable Development Goals, gender equality must be integrated in all our 
efforts. We must invest in girls and women. In their education, in their health, and in 
their participation in the labour market. Increasing their opportunities and levelling 
the playing field pays great economic dividends.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: Eradicating poverty is the greatest global challenge.
paragraphs.raw_text: Eradicating poverty is the greatest global challenge.

paragraphs.text: The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is our plan of action for people, for the planet and for prosperity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is our plan of action for people, 
for the planet and for prosperity.

paragraphs.text: There is a danger that this pandemic may reverse years of progress on the SDGs. It has laid bare the weaknesses in our common systems. Extreme poverty is increasing, jobs are being lost at an unprecedented scale, and children are being deprived of their education. We have no alternative but to take decisive action now, and redouble our efforts to reach the sustainable development goals.
paragraphs.raw_text:
There is a danger that this pandemic may reverse years of progress on the 
SDGs. It has laid bare the weaknesses in our common systems. Extreme poverty 
is increasing, jobs are being lost at an unprecedented scale, and children are being 
deprived of their education. We have no alternative but to take decisive action now, 
and redouble our efforts to reach the sustainable development goals.

paragraphs.text: In our continued quest to achieve these goals, national ownership and resource mobilization is crucial.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In our continued quest to achieve these goals, national ownership and resource 
mobilization is crucial.

paragraphs.text: Progress requires financing. We acknowledged this in the Addis Ababa Action Agenda on financing for development. Funding sustainable development is more critical now than ever. The pandemic has exposed and compounded structural inequalities in all countries. Our response must focus on helping those furthest behind. The Addis Agenda highlights the importance of domestic resource mobilization in order to provide basic public goods and services.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Progress requires financing. We acknowledged this in the Addis Ababa 
Action Agenda on financing for development. Funding sustainable development is 
more critical now than ever. The pandemic has exposed and compounded structural 
inequalities in all countries. Our response must focus on helping those furthest behind. 
The Addis Agenda highlights the importance of domestic resource mobilization in 
order to provide basic public goods and services.

paragraphs.text: Yet public goods and services, such as health care and education, remain underfunded. We need to stop the drain on public resources. We must prevent corruption, tax evasion and other financial crime.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Yet public goods and services, such as health care and education, remain 
underfunded. We need to stop the drain on public resources. We must prevent 
corruption, tax evasion and other financial crime.

paragraphs.text: To this end, Norway in its capacity as ECOSOC President launched a High- Level Panel on Financial Accountability, Transparency and Integrity — the FACTI panel — together with the President of the 74th General Assembly. The Panel will review current challenges and offer recommendations related to illicit financial flows.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To this end, Norway in its capacity as ECOSOC President launched a High-
Level Panel on Financial Accountability, Transparency and Integrity — the FACTI 
panel — together with the President of the 74th General Assembly. The Panel will 
review current challenges and offer recommendations related to illicit financial flows.

paragraphs.text: It is a common responsibility of all Member States to make sure there are no safe havens for the proceeds of crime, corruption or tax evasion.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It is a common responsibility of all Member States to make sure there are no 
safe havens for the proceeds of crime, corruption or tax evasion.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: We need a healthy planet to fulfil the SDGs.
paragraphs.raw_text: We need a healthy planet to fulfil the SDGs.

paragraphs.text: Many Member States are facing climate related disasters — more frequent and more dangerous than ever before. The most vulnerable among us are hardest hit. The threat to small island states is existential. The people in the Sahel are among the most vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change. Yet they are among the world’s lowest emitters of CO2. It is our common obligation to invest in resilience, especially in the parts of the world most adversely affected by climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Many Member States are facing climate related disasters — more frequent and 
more dangerous than ever before. The most vulnerable among us are hardest hit. The 
threat to small island states is existential. The people in the Sahel are among the most 
vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change. Yet they are among the world’s 
lowest emitters of CO2. It is our common obligation to invest in resilience, especially 
in the parts of the world most adversely affected by climate change.

paragraphs.text: 2020 remains the crucial year for countries to update and strengthen their national climate targets under the Paris Agreement. In February, Norway submitted an enhanced climate target for 2030. I encourage other countries to enhance their
paragraphs.raw_text:
2020 remains the crucial year for countries to update and strengthen their 
national climate targets under the Paris Agreement. In February, Norway submitted 
an enhanced climate target for 2030. I encourage other countries to enhance their

paragraphs.text: ambitions, especially the large economies. We must also give priority to further development of rules and cooperation under the Paris Agreement.
paragraphs.raw_text:
ambitions, especially the large economies. We must also give priority to further 
development of rules and cooperation under the Paris Agreement.

paragraphs.text: Norway is actively speeding up the green shift in our economy, making it cheaper to be green, and more expensive to pollute.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Norway is actively speeding up the green shift in our economy, making it 
cheaper to be green, and more expensive to pollute.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: The oceans are a vital factor if we are to reach the Sustainable Development Goals. The COVID-19 crisis has underlined the importance of the ocean economy. We need to build back not only better and greener, but also bluer.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The oceans are a vital factor if we are to reach the Sustainable Development 
Goals. The COVID-19 crisis has underlined the importance of the ocean economy. 
We need to build back not only better and greener, but also bluer.

paragraphs.text: A sustainable ocean economy holds benefits for health and society, as well as for the global economy and environment. Every dollar invested in key ocean actions yields 5 dollars in return, often more. Actions include increasing sustainable seafood production, decarbonising international shipping, scaling up offshore wind power and conserving and restoring mangroves.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A sustainable ocean economy holds benefits for health and society, as well as 
for the global economy and environment. Every dollar invested in key ocean actions 
yields 5 dollars in return, often more. Actions include increasing sustainable seafood 
production, decarbonising international shipping, scaling up offshore wind power 
and conserving and restoring mangroves.

paragraphs.text: Responsible resource management increases the potential for economic growth.
paragraphs.raw_text: Responsible resource management increases the potential for economic growth.

paragraphs.text: Two years ago, I convened the High-level Panel on Building a Sustainable Ocean Economy, together with the president of Palau.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Two years ago, I convened the High-level Panel on Building a Sustainable 
Ocean Economy, together with the president of Palau.

paragraphs.text: The panel is comprised of fourteen distinguished members. On December 3rd we will present ways forward to better protect our ocean and release the enormous economic potential it holds.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The panel is comprised of fourteen distinguished members. On December 3rd 
we will present ways forward to better protect our ocean and release the enormous 
economic potential it holds.

paragraphs.text: Our recommendations are based on the best advice from more than 150 international scientists and a wide network of business and NGOs. We will invite the international community to join this call for ocean action leading up to the UN Ocean Conference in Lisbon next year.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Our recommendations are based on the best advice from more than 150 
international scientists and a wide network of business and NGOs. We will invite the 
international community to join this call for ocean action leading up to the UN Ocean 
Conference in Lisbon next year.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: I would like to draw attention to the challenges seafarers are facing in this crisis. Around 500,000 seafarers currently await to disembark or embark ships and vessels globally.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to draw attention to the challenges seafarers are facing in this 
crisis. Around 500,000 seafarers currently await to disembark or embark ships and 
vessels globally.

paragraphs.text: Almost 80 per cent of the world’s trade is transported by ship, including food, medical equipment and energy products. If the crisis persists, it can lead to major disruption of global trade, supply chains and the world economy. I encourage all Member States to designate seafarers as key workers and to implement the International Maritime Organisation´s protocols for crew changes.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Almost 80 per cent of the world’s trade is transported by ship, including 
food, medical equipment and energy products. If the crisis persists, it can lead to 
major disruption of global trade, supply chains and the world economy. I encourage 
all Member States to designate seafarers as key workers and to implement the 
International Maritime Organisation´s protocols for crew changes.

paragraphs.text: President,
paragraphs.raw_text: President,

paragraphs.text: COVID-19 is putting us all to the test. Information, research, treatment and vaccines must be shared in a way that leaves no-one behind. If not, we all stand to lose.
paragraphs.raw_text:
COVID-19 is putting us all to the test. Information, research, treatment and 
vaccines must be shared in a way that leaves no-one behind. If not, we all stand 
to lose.

paragraphs.text: I started by saying that the United Nations was born out of hope. While we can always do better, I find hope in the way we have come together in this race against time. We are united against a common enemy. We have been reminded of a simple fact: We are in this together. There is no stronger argument for our continued support for the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I started by saying that the United Nations was born out of hope. While we can 
always do better, I find hope in the way we have come together in this race against

paragraphs.text: Thank you, and stay safe.
